SWEEP COMPLETE. All seven slices closed and on main at cb16e8a.

  slice 1  embed-core                              0a65e79
  slice 2  core (Credence, spans, StorySource, ClaimMeta)  874fc61
  slice 3  features + align + grakern (Coverage)   2c3dd34
  slice 5  document + interview + acquire          812e935
  slice 6  codec (Checked* witnesses, hiding type) 8e445e7
  slice 7  phantom witnesses (AmrGraph, PropositionChart, StoryModel)  9e20611
  plus the SurfaceDetail provider 967e5d75, which carried the same obligation for a NEW type.

Every slice was gated on a merged tree with a captured exit status. The last one, slice 3, was the first time the pre-landing tree recompute actually fired -- and narrowing to build-relevant paths showed the delta was entirely .mote/ops bookkeeping, so the gate held.

The population this bead named -- private-constructor case classes defeated by Mirror.fromProduct -- is closed. The complementary population it CANNOT see is split out as bd-01M16WATA75CBRRB9X9ZKJF2MS: validators returning their own input type on publicly-constructible types, 8 of 9 measured, with ClaimMeta as the control that proves the screen discriminates. Splitting rather than noting, so it does not get buried in a closed record.

Also opened by this work: bd-01M16V1QAXR4JT1F174H2BTQT3 (RecallGraph) and the forward obligation in AGENTS.md rule 8 that new public proof types must be BORN unforgeable -- added after a new candidate introduced the defect in the same hours slice 2 was removing it.
